title: Funded: $400 under $2,000 room, $800 above + $1,500 best-day cap
question: After the MFFU eval passes: which LIT size maximises $ withdrawn per funded account over 3 / 6 months and keeps the account alive?
verdict: Funded MFFU Builder 50K, Monte Carlo 2,000 x 6 months, $1.90 commission, H1 / H2: account lost 3 mo 0.8% / 1.7%, 6 mo 1.6% / 3.2%; paid to the trader 3 mo $1,918 / $1,507, 6 mo $4,604 / $3,929 ($767 / $655 a month); median first payout session 29.0 / 34.0; 5 payouts within 6 mo 22.7% / 16.8%; median max DD $-1,420 / $-1,390. Back to back on real history: H1 {'accounts': 1, 'lost': 0, 'graduated': 0, 'open_at_end': 1, 'paid': 5434, 'per_month': 892, 'first_payout_sessions': [4], 'worst_dd': -1470}, H2 {'accounts': 1, 'lost': 0, 'graduated': 0, 'open_at_end': 1, 'paid': 1160, 'per_month': 312, 'first_payout_sessions': [75], 'worst_dd': -842}, 2021-25 (ref) {'accounts': 1, 'lost': 0, 'graduated': 0, 'open_at_end': 1, 'paid': 2614, 'per_month': 51, 'first_payout_sessions': [137], 'worst_dd': -3465}.
notes: tools/lit_funded.py; sizing engine/sizing.funded_qty; MFFU Builder 50K sim-funded as modelled (research/lit/mffu_rules.json: EOD trailing $2,000 locking at +$100, $1,000 soft daily loss, payout: balance - $2,100 >= $500, max $2,000, best day <= 50% of the cycle, 2 traded days, 5 sim payouts, 80%). Stored trades = the back-to-back funded path (state-dependent size); the library's eval columns are not the funded numbers (those are in the verdict). 2021-25 = 5m entries, reference only.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
